# Happy Go Lucky

> Official brand book for Happy Go Lucky, a thoughtful gifting brand with a cheerful Jester voice and caring heart.

Use this source when creating Happy Go Lucky designs, campaigns, product copy, packaging, interfaces, or social content. Preserve its kind humour, clear facts, supplied colour palette, and typography direction.

## Canonical resources

- [Complete brand book](brand-book.md): Full human-readable and AI-readable Markdown source.
- [Complete LLM context](llms-full.txt): Full plain-text context for language models.
- [XML brand book](brand-book.xml): Structured XML edition.
- [DXT document](brand-book.dxt): Portable text document edition.
- [Visual brand book](./): Designed browser experience.

## Core identity

- Slogan: Gift happy. Get lucky.
- Personality: cheerful, thoughtful, witty, warm, honest.
- Colours: #F8E656, #00BF63, #F5F5F5, #302F34.
- Body typeface: Poppins.
- Archetype: 70% Jester / 30% Caregiver.
